title: Familiarity understands the gesture
literal_meaning: A mother understands the gestures of her deaf child.
meaning_odia: ଯାହା ସହିତ ନିତି ଚଳପ୍ରଚଳ ଓ ଘନିଷ୍ଠତା ଥାଏ, ତାଙ୍କର ଇଙ୍ଗିତ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଓ ସ୍ୱଭାବ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ବୁଝିହୁଏ। ମାଆ ନିଜ ଶ୍ରବଣହୀନ ସନ୍ତାନର ଠାର ବୁଝିବାର ଚିତ୍ରରେ ସେହି ପରିଚୟର ଶକ୍ତି ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: Close and repeated contact makes another person’s meaning easier to understand. The inspected source gloss emphasizes knowing someone’s intentions and ways through everyday association. The mother and child provide the saying’s concrete image of that familiarity.
usage_example: Two longtime colleagues understand a small gesture during a busy performance, while a newcomer needs the cue explained. Someone recalls the saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The focus is a familiar gesture and the person who recognizes it. The mother-child relationship makes the repeated attention behind that recognition easy to picture.

witnesses.locator: Page10, single line beginning କାଲ ଠାର.

witnesses.note: Prints ଠାରେ rather than uploaded ଠାର. Explicit gloss concerns understanding through constant association.

variants.locator: Page32, first item beginning ଭୀମ ବଳ.
variants.note: Related-family wording grouped editorially with POD-DHAGA-406 for close maternal knowledge; no textual descent asserted. Literal reading: Bhima’s strength is known to Kuinta. Odia meaning: ଭୀମଙ୍କ ବଳ କୁଇନ୍ତାଙ୍କୁ ଜଣା—ଏହା ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର ସିଧା କଥା। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ଘନିଷ୍ଠ ପରିଚୟ ଥିବା ଲୋକ ଜଣଙ୍କ ପ୍ରକୃତ ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ଜାଣିଥାନ୍ତି। କୁଇନ୍ତା ନାମର ମୂଳ ବନାନ ରଖାଯାଇଛି; ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ପ୍ରତିରୂପରେ ଏହା ଭୀମଙ୍କ ମାଆ କୁନ୍ତୀଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ। Interpretive reading: The saying places knowledge of Bhima’s strength with Kuinta, identified as his mother Kunti in the inspected public counterpart. Read editorially, a close acquaintance can know a person’s real capacity. The wording neither says that only she knows nor supplies a particular episode proving the strength. Name reference: Satya Prakash, କଥାଣି୨, section21, https://satyaprakashsethy.com/କଥାଣି-୨/ , inspected17November2026, identifies କୁଇନ୍ତା as mother Kunti; its wording differs. Uploaded spelling retained without repair. No epic-origin claim. Source quotation has unknown rights and is excluded from the collection’s original editorial-content licence.
